notes.title: Platonic Love Bundle!
notes.content:
We’re delighted to announce that we’ve teamed up with the teams behind Boyfriend Dungeon and 
Goodbye Volcano High to bring you the Platonic Love Bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39265/Platonic_Love_Bundle/

You already know Monster Loves You Too, the coming-of-age story in a world of monsters where your
own instincts are just as dangerous as the world around you. Here’s a bit about the other games in the
bundle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/aceaf74b7a337a5263d88119f77f2983c3faa3c2.gif[/img]

Goodbye Volcano High is also a coming-of-age story, set in a dinosaur highs chool right before the
meteor. It has gorgeous cutscenes, wonderful voice acting and truly expressive choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/0b6cc7753a9c517bd9727b7808688cc961ccffef.gif[/img]

Boyfriend Dungeon is a dungeon crawl/dating sim mashup where you date your weapons! For every
weapon, there’s also an option to form a strong platonic relationship. In fact, only platonic options are available for Pocket, the brass-knuckles / cat.

Buy the bundle today while they’re all on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39265/Platonic_Love_Bundle/

notes.title: Monster Loves You Too! Launches NEXT WEEK - December 7th, 2023!
notes.content:
A hundred years have passed since Monstrous eyes have last spotted a Human, and the fabled Village of Omen is but a distant memory. Yet, the saga of survival and identity continues in the monstrous land of Asch on [b]Thursday, December 7th, 2023[/b]!

You’ll be imperiled from the instant you emerge from your slime vat. Peril from foes. Peril from strangers. More peril from your own allies. Pretty much everyone you meet, really. Your life will be a tapestry woven from an ensemble of characters both daunting and bizarre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/1ae025a601435c038899ad46b7b9cdd0359cdeee.jpg[/img]
You'll find yourself in situations where battle is inevitable, be it against ancient rivals or unforeseen adversaries. In these moments, your ability to strategize, out-think, and outmaneuver your opponents will become as crucial as your claws. Every confrontation will be a test of your intellect and creativity, challenging you to use your brains to outwit foes in scenarios where raw power alone isn't enough. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/886f3f3fd8db8685678ba47b89743c17c67f183a.png[/img]
You will navigate through a society where your wits are as crucial as your might. Your story won’t just be one of survival, but about controlling your own Monstrous instincts for the greater good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/9400d167a0b4fe24b57a246c7879c578b30e4bb0.png[/img]
Expect to encounter a host of extraordinary creatures, each with their own twisted tales and motivations. From the enigmatic shadows of the City of Asch, figures both fearsome and whimsical will emerge. Some may become staunch allies; others, formidable foes. But remember, in this world, trust is a commodity as rare as it is valuable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/8bae4e9b06b453186e56dac993246f8658df8f3a.jpg[/img]
Your journey will be fraught with challenges that test your mettle. You will be hunted, ensnared, and thrust into situations that demand the utmost cunning and courage. Yet, amidst this chaos, the chance for friendship, and even kinship, might blossom in the most unexpected places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/0a30de59b5ffe7dec6153850c5b3a12da46f6a63.png[/img]
Join us in the City of Asch on December 7th. Play in a world where monsters reign and legends are born. Your life as a Monster awaits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/2366050b2e1d295eb5bd72ca342baffea5a51a8c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40322699/9d2379993c6e340a26ebe7ee25f165aa4281d8d3.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149000/Monster_Loves_You_Too/

More info: https://monsterlovesyou.com/
